curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the duty to obey signs, then teach shape and color as the fast way to name a sign, then the stop, yield, Do Not Enter and no-turn rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per red sign rule plus contrast cards for octagon, triangle and square.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that describes a sign by shape and color and asks what the driver must do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the white rectangle family first, then the turn and pedestrian rules, then each special lane and who may use it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign meaning; contrast cards for transit lane use and for the center turn lane versus the carpool lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz built on lane and turn scenarios where two white signs are easy to swap.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what yellow warning signs are for, then walk through curve signs, intersection signs and the signs about lanes joining, ending or changing direction.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per warning sign; contrast cards for curve signs and for merge, added lane and lane reduction.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a warning sign and asks what lies ahead and how to respond.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover pedestrian crossing warnings, then the signs that announce a stop, a signal, a lower limit or a roundabout, then clearance, hill, wet pavement and deer.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign; a contrast card for a coming speed limit versus an advisory speed.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what to prepare for when each advance warning appears.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach route and green guide signs, then safety corridors, then the brown and blue sign families by what they point to.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign family; contrast cards for green versus brown and for the blue hospital sign.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a destination and asks which color of sign leads to it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach steady red, flashing red and dark signals, then exactly which turns are allowed after a full stop on red, including on a red arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per red signal; contrast cards for steady versus flashing red and right versus left on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz with intersection scenarios on whether a turn on red is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach steady and flashing yellow, then the two yellow arrows, then the circular green light versus the green arrow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per light; contrast cards for steady versus flashing yellow arrows and for green arrow versus green ball.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who has the right of way under each yellow and green indication.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec02-m01..sec02-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
